label: Child

label: Adult

label: Side quests

label: Gold Skulltulas
reward: At the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village: 10 = Adult's Wallet (500 Rupees) · 20 = Echo Gem (replaces the Stone of Agony) · 30 = Giant's Wallet (1,000 Rupees) · 40 = 20 Bombchus · 50 = Piece of Heart · 100 = Gold Rupee.
note: Still 100 in the remake. Map positions come from the earlier game and some moved: those in Kakariko Village, Zora Fountain, the market, Zora's River and the Forest and Water Temples are marked unconfirmed. Many only appear at night.

label: Pieces of Heart
reward: Every four pieces add up to a heart container.
note: List from the 3DS version, pending confirmation for the remake.
